result.rule: On the primary set under frame set (all entries, hub-corrected form, every cell): while more than 10% of the stand-ins that are not yet word columns have p below 0.05, or any of them has p below 0.01, the one with the lowest p joins the word columns in both forms and the word model is refitted. At most 20 additions. Decided with words alone, before any unit exists.
